records.subject: MSE
records.title: Materials Engineering Fundamentals
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHEM 105 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Introduction to the fundamental concepts of materials engineering.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Materials Science Fundamentals
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHEM 106 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; MSE 201 with a C or better.
records.description: Introduction to the fundamental concepts of materials science.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Engineering Computations
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 273 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; 4 credits of PHYSICS 201 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment, or PHYSICS 201 and 211 both with a C or better, or both with concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Introduction to the computational methods used for solving numerical problems in engineering. (Crosslisted course offered as ME 241, MSE 241.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Electronic Materials
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHEM 105 with a C or better; 4 credits of PHYSICS 202 with a C or better, or PHYSICS 202 and 212 both with a C or better or concurrent enrollment, or PHYSICS 206 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Structure of materials, electronic structure of solids; thermal, electrical, dielectric, and magnetic properties of materials; semiconductors processing.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Thermodynamics and Kinetics of Materials
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MSE 202 with a C or better.
records.description: Laws of thermodynamics, solution thermodynamics, free energy composition diagrams, mechanisms and kinetics of diffusion; solidification behavior, interfaces and phase boundaries, phase transformations in solids, oxidation, and corrosion.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Materials Design
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ECONS 102; MSE 201 with a C or better; MSE 241 with a C or better; STAT 370 with a C or better.
records.description: Materials selection and processing design routes to develop new materials for engineering applications.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Materials Structure - Properties Lab
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MSE 201 with a C or better; MSE 202 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Principles and techniques of optical metallography and other laboratory methods used in modern materials science and engineering.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Materials Characterization
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MSE 201 with a C or better.
records.description: Properties of x-rays, scattering and diffraction; crystal structures; x-ray diffraction methods, transmission electron microscopy and scanning electron microscopy.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Materials Characterization Lab
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MSE 321 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Laboratory exercises on materials characterization: x-ray, TEM, SEM.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Metallic Materials
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MSE 201 with a C or better.
records.description: Major alloy systems and manufacturing processes; materials selection.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Polymeric Materials
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MSE 201 with a C or better.
records.description: Structural characterization, syntheses, and reactions of polymeric materials; relationships between structure and properties, viscoelasticity, deformation, and physical behavior of polymers.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Ceramic Materials
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MSE 201 with a C or better.
records.description: Processing, characteristics, microstructure, and properties of ceramic materials.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Engineering Composites
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MSE 201 with a C or better.
records.description: Basic concept in design and specifications of engineering composites.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Biomaterials
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MSE 201 with a C or better.
records.description: Overview of the different types of materials used in biomedical applications such as implants and medical devices. Credit not granted for both MSE 406 and MSE 506.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Semiconductor Processing and Fabrication
records.description: Introduction to semiconductors and semiconductor fabrication process, including oxidation, diffusion, photolithography, plasma and acid etching, thin film deposition, and device fabrication.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Mechanical Behavior of Materials
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CE 215 and MSE 201, both with a C or better; OR MSE 202 with a C or better.
records.description: Elasticity, elastic stress distributions; plastic deformation of single and polycrystals; introduction to dislocation theory and its applications; creep, fracture, fatigue. (Crosslisted course offered as MSE 413, ME 413.)

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Senior Thesis I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MSE 320 with a C or better; MSE 323 with a C or better; admitted to MSE; senior standing, OR MSE 318 with a C or better; MSE 323 with a C or better; two from MSE 331, 332, or 333 with a C or better; admitted to MSE; senior standing.
records.description: Research in materials science and engineering.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Nanoscale Materials and Nanotechnology
records.description: Introduction to nanoscience, nanoscale materials, and modern nanotechnology including structure, fabrication, and applications.  (Crosslisted course offered as MSE 431, ME 431.)

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Fission and Fusion Materials
records.description: Understanding key mechanisms affecting material behavior in fission and fusion reactors, material degradation mechanisms, development of irradiation-tolerant materials, nuclear fuel cycle and waste management strategies. (Crosslisted course offered as MSE 463, ME 463.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Topics in Materials Engineering
records.description: Contemporary topics in materials engineering.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Professional Practice Coop/Internship I
records.description: Practicum for students admitted to the VCEA Professional Practice and Experiential Learning Program; integration of coursework with on-the-job professional experience. (Crosslisted course offered as ENGR 488, BIO ENG 488, CHE 488, CE 488, CPT S 488, E E 488, ME 488, MSE 488, SDC 488.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: MSE
records.title: Special Problems
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.
